experiment.question: Is there a currently available paid contractor assignment for the reported Open Food Network Canada map defect?
experiment.success_signal: Written confirmation of current eligibility, terms and funded scope by an authorized maintainer, not a generic invitation.
experiment.stop_signal: Only an unpaid onboarding route or no funded scope after the defined outreach/check; pause rather than invest development effort.

experiment.question: Can the reported Foodsoft reconciliation defect be reproduced and tied to an operator prepared to fund its repair?
experiment.success_signal: Regression fixture reproduces issue, maintainer accepts technical scope, and an operator independently confirms funded need.
experiment.stop_signal: Bug is already fixed or nobody identifies a paid business need; retain as optional OSS credibility work.

experiment.question: Can an independent rooftop PV performance report supply economically valuable analysis beyond existing vendor monitoring?
experiment.success_signal: A site owner authorizes an anonymized data sample, describes an existing monitoring gap and confirms a price/budget under a bounded delivery proposal.
experiment.stop_signal: Available vendor tools cover the use case adequately or buyer has no budget; do not build an unnecessary monitoring product.

experiment.question: Does a minimal Kobo-based photograph, location and time survey preserve enough field data to support a separate dog identity-reconciliation workflow?
experiment.success_signal: Local authorized offline workflow produces consistent test records and an identifiable operator verifies the data specification.
experiment.stop_signal: Data cannot be reconciled reliably or there is no operator need; stop before developing speculative identity software.
